intent: Let reviewed Run and Registry facts constrain implementation, under an approval a verifier can check.
observable_outcome: A coding Agent reading Domain Memory receives Run ownership and the Run-Registry collaboration as reviewed constraints rather than working-memory drafts.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Run owns its lifecycle transitions and that ownership is a reviewed record backed by cited, current evidence.
The Registry-to-Run fact reader is a reviewed contract with a reviewed synchronous interaction, so a later change cannot quietly widen it.
The approval that promotes these records is checkable outside the package, against the signature on the commit that carries it.

open_questions: vocabulary/run and rules/run-lifecycle-owner stay candidates; see the proposal.
